h1_title: QRCode MAKER - Make QRCode and easily download
desc: You can easily build QRCode and download
about_desc: Enter any text or URL, then customize the color, size, and optionally add your own logo — your QR code is generated instantly. Everything happens locally in your browser, so your text is never uploaded to a server. Once you're happy with the result, download it as a PNG and use it anywhere: print, business cards, posters, or share online.
